clues: A French city on the Mediterranean Sea, on the south-east coast. It is one of the largest French cities on that shore.
Winters here are mild, not harsh and cold. Rich folk from cold lands came to spend each winter here.
Greek settlers from Marseille founded this town around 350 BC. They named it for their goddess of victory.
The clear air and soft light drew famed painters here. The work of Marc Chagall and Henri Matisse fills its art museums.
Its famed seaside stroll is the Promenade des Anglais. English guests who wintered here long ago gave that walk its name.
